neighbours.label: a word that completes an expected phrase after a preposition or possessive (years of study and preparation; accede to his desire; longsought victory)
fire: After years of study and preparation, the bureau released its first survey.

After months of training and preparation, the team was ready to climb.
It was a hard-won victory for the small party after a long campaign.
Following weeks of planning and preparation, the festival opened on time.
